# THERMOTECH ENGINEERING

> THERMOTECH ENGINEERING is a manufacturer of industrial hot-water and steam boilers rated from 5 MW to 25 MW for district heating, process heat, utility steam, and boiler-room retrofit projects. The standard product line includes TM-5, TM-12, and TM-25 platforms with PLC/HMI control, pressure-part documentation, and ISO/GOST conformity support.

## Core capabilities

- Industrial hot-water boilers: 5 MW to 25 MW thermal output.
- Industrial steam boilers: 5 MW to 25 MW thermal output.
- Fuels: natural gas, light oil, dual-fuel, and alternative-fuel configurations where applicable.
- Design pressure: representative range 1.0 MPa to 2.5 MPa.
- Design temperature: representative range 150 °C to 250 °C.
- Automation: PLC, HMI, burner management, flame safeguard, alarm annunciation, DCS integration.
- Documentation: material certificates, welding records, pressure-test reports, conformity declarations.

## Standard product line

### TM-5 Hot-Water Boiler
- Thermal output: 5 MW
- Medium: hot water
- Representative design pressure: 1.0 MPa
- Representative design temperature: 150 °C
- Representative efficiency: 93% net HHV
- Representative NOx: ≤ 80 mg/Nm³
- Automation: PLC + HMI

### TM-12 Steam Boiler
- Thermal output: 12 MW
- Medium: steam
- Representative design pressure: 1.6 MPa
- Representative design temperature: 200 °C
- Representative efficiency: 94% net HHV
- Representative NOx: ≤ 70 mg/Nm³
- Automation: PLC + HMI + remote diagnostics

### TM-25 Hot-Water / Steam Boiler
- Thermal output: 25 MW
- Medium: hot water / steam
- Representative design pressure: 2.5 MPa
- Representative design temperature: 250 °C
- Representative efficiency: 95% net HHV
- Representative NOx: ≤ 60 mg/Nm³
- Automation: PLC + HMI + DCS integration

## Certifications and documentation

- ISO 9001 quality management support.
- ISO 14001 environmental management support.
- ISO 45001 occupational health and safety management support.
- GOST conformity assessment documentation for applicable markets.
- Pressure-equipment documentation packages by project scope.

## FAQ

### What output range do Thermotech boilers cover?
The standard product line covers 5 MW, 12 MW, and 25 MW thermal output. Custom variants can be engineered for adjacent duties when the required pressure, temperature, fuel, and site constraints are compatible with the base design.

### Can the boilers operate on fuels other than natural gas?
Yes. The standard burners are configured for natural gas or light oil. Dual-fuel and alternative-fuel configurations can be specified with the appropriate burner, control, and safety package.

### What automation and control systems are supplied?
Each boiler is delivered with PLC-based control, local HMI, safety interlocks, and standard communication interfaces. DCS integration, remote diagnostics, and advanced load-management packages are available on request.

### Which codes and certifications are covered?
Design, fabrication, and testing can be executed to ISO, GOST, and applicable national pressure-equipment requirements. Documentation packages include material certificates, welding records, pressure-test reports, and conformity declarations.

### What site information is needed for a quotation?
Please provide required duty, medium, pressure and temperature, fuel availability, ambient conditions, water quality, electrical supply, installation constraints, and any local regulatory requirements.
